_comment: Codex hooks template covering all 6 lifecycle events. Drop into .codex/hooks.json (preferred) or merge as inline [hooks] table into .codex/config.toml. Reference: https://developers.openai.com/codex/hooks

_schema_summary.matcher: regex string applied to the event-specific field (tool name for *ToolUse / PermissionRequest; source for SessionStart). Use '*', '', or omit for universal match.
_schema_summary.concurrency: Multiple matching hooks for the same event run in PARALLEL — one cannot prevent another from starting.

exit_code_protocol.0: success; stdout parsed as optional JSON output (or used as plain-text context)
exit_code_protocol.2: blocking signal; stderr is the rejection reason

_schema_summary.json_output_compatibility: Codex's JSON output schema is intentionally Claude-compatible: hookSpecificOutput, permissionDecision, decision='block', additionalContext, continue: false.

_inline_toml_equivalent:
If you prefer .codex/config.toml inline:

[features]
codex_hooks = true

[[hooks.SessionStart]]
matcher = "startup|resume"

[[hooks.SessionStart.hooks]]
type = "command"
command = "bash .codex/hooks/scripts/session-start-status.sh"
timeout = 60

[[hooks.PreToolUse]]
matcher = "Bash|^apply_patch$"

[[hooks.PreToolUse.hooks]]
type = "command"
command = "bash .codex/hooks/scripts/pre-tool-sanitize.sh"
_managed_hooks_enterprise: For enterprise distribution, use Requirements.toml managed_dir to centralize hook scripts. Codex pulls scripts from the managed directory; the JSON config above only references commands, not script content.
